reuse.why: Adds the closed-account rule to the existing pre-link guard that all six provider link handlers already call.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; the provider handlers only pick up the renamed guard.

placement.why: The check sits in the shared pre-link guard in accounts/app.ts, which runs before any bank, account or sync side effect.

scope.why: Focused, though renaming the guard touches all six call sites for a naming improvement rather than behaviour.

maintainability.why: One guard now holds every 'may this link proceed' rule under a name that says so.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider link handler calls assertBankAccountCanBeLinked.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountCanBeLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called by the GoCardless, SimpleFin, PluggyAI, Fintegra, Akahu and Enable Banking link handlers.
